endomorphism_certificate.conclusion: End^0(X)=Q(i), by the existing algebraic-independence argument and rational lattice homomorphism algebraization.

symmetry.automorphism: tau=i on X and diagonally on every power
symmetry.reason: Rosati on Q(i) is conjugation; divisor classes correspond to Rosati-symmetric matrices over Q(i), all commuting with central i.

library.objects: Smooth powers X^r for finite positive r, using their product polarization
library.degree_policy: For f:X^r->X^s, pullback preserves codimension; proper pushforward changes codimension p to p+6(s-r). Rational Chow pullback uses the standard smooth-power intersection-theoretic construction.
library.closure_result: Every resulting cohomology class is tau-invariant. Its degree-six Weil projection on X is zero.

fourier_control.normalization: No division by 3; integrate with the complex orientation, negative of the fixed real lattice orientation.

positive_reduction: Seek a positive-rank algebraic vector bundle G with O(kappa_3(G)) nonzero, where kappa(G)=ch(G)exp(-c1(G)/rank(G)). Since c1(G) is proportional to E and O(E*H^4)=0, O(kappa_3(G))=O(ch_3(G)). This existence is equivalent to alpha algebraic, using finite locally free resolutions and the prior witness conversion.
